_comment: Rewritten 2026-08-29 (D17). The previous contents described sprint/2026-08-20-5, a branch
that no longer exists (deleted with 15 other fully-merged refs under D16), cited ROADMAP
revision 3 as 'uncommitted there' when revision 4 has since been merged, and listed three
verifications as owed when two of them had run. A state file that describes a deleted branch
is worse than an absent one: /sprint resolves it first and would have resumed into nothing.
DO NOT hand-edit the shipped list to look tidy. This records what ran, and its value is that
it can be checked against `git log` — every entry below carries the merged PR.
